review_scope: Assistant technical source review; not independent human/legal approval.
change_classes: paragraphs broken mid-sentence (page break, hanging indent or justified-line split) rejoined; each break was checked against the page image or the relay layout before joining
25 glued formula-variable sub/superscripts written as LaTeX ($_{…}$ / $^{…}$), each token checked against the PDF glyph size and baseline; occurrences the PDF prints plain stay plain (scriptfix.py)
whitespace only: justified-text runs of spaces collapsed and paragraph indentation removed (4+ leading spaces rendered paragraphs as code blocks); non-whitespace characters unchanged (wsclean.py)
